response.title: Is it cheaper to buy a solar generator bundle or buy the power station and solar panels separately?
response.answer:
Buying a power station and solar panels separately is often cheaper, especially if you're willing to use compatible third-party solar panels instead of the power station manufacturer's panels.

However, a solar generator bundle can be cheaper during promotions, particularly from brands like EcoFlow, Jackery, Bluetti, and Anker.

The best option depends on the total price, solar panel wattage, and whether you need portable or stationary panels.

| Compatibility | Generally guaranteed | Must verify voltage and connectors |

| Flexibility | Less flexible | More flexible |
| Best for | Convenience and portability | Lowest cost and customization |

| Configuration | Bundle | Same parts separately | Savings |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| EcoFlow DELTA 3 Plus + 220W | $919 | $1,118 | $199 |
| Jackery Explorer 1000 v2 + 200W | $719 | $898 | $179 |
| Bluetti AC180 + 200W | $769 | $898 | $129 |
